personal.title: Enterprise Deployment & Automation Lead
personal.abstract: Enterprise deployment and project delivery professional who turns complex, unfamiliar business operations into clear, high-impact automation roadmaps. I partner with technical and executive stakeholders to map processes, define governance and operating models, and prioritize initiatives by ROI — driving adoption of SaaS, workflow, and AI-driven automation in regulated, high-stakes environments. Equally comfortable in an executive kickoff and a hands-on delivery session, I make technical concepts clear, build trust across teams, and leave organizations more capable of scaling automation on their own.

experience.title: Product Manager
responsibilities: Lead end-to-end delivery of 3 SaaS products in highly regulated environments, from roadmap definition to rollout and post-launch adoption
Partner with engineering to translate customer pain points into adopted workflows, defining requirements and validating API integrations (Swagger, Postman, Apidog)
Establish governance and QA operating models with automated testing (Robot Framework) and API validation to make quality a repeatable, scalable practice
Coordinate cross-functional workflows across multiple teams using Azure DevOps and Wrike, aligning technical and business priorities
Experiment with AI/LLM-assisted automation to streamline validation and documentation workflows

experience.title: Project Manager
responsibilities: Owned end-to-end delivery of 18–22 concurrent projects for large enterprise clients, from scoping and planning to execution and closeout
Built trust and alignment across business, compliance, and technical stakeholders in complex, high-stakes environments
Prioritized initiatives by business outcome, sequencing roadmaps and managing competing priorities to focus on the highest-value work
Guided clients through change management and new ways of working, tracking success metrics and adoption

experience.title: Project Consultant
responsibilities: Led on-site and remote enterprise deployments, mapping unfamiliar business operations to uncover high-impact automation and digitization opportunities
Redesigned client workflows around ERP, EDI, WMS, CRM, e-invoicing and eCommerce, building the case for automation-first ways of working
Implemented PEPPOL and MyData compliance standards, partnering with development teams to turn business needs into delivered integrations

experience.title: Greek Military Service
responsibilities: Provided technical support, troubleshooting hardware and network issues
Assisted in administration of resources and managed communication systems

experience.title: IT & Digital Transformation Coordinator
responsibilities: Drove end-to-end digital transformation, identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing solutions to improve business performance
Partnered with stakeholders to adopt ERP, CRM, and eCommerce platforms, embedding new tools into how the organization worked
Managed IT infrastructure across hardware, software, networks, servers, and operating systems
